verdict.rationale: HelixDB ships an official `helix` CLI with getting-started docs and a command reference covering auth, workspaces, projects, databases and clusters. It offers a `--format human|json` output mode, and `helix chef` automates agent setup by installing query skills and a docs MCP, which suits AI-native workflows. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use, and evidence that JSON output is available across commands beyond `cluster list`.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: `helix chef` can automate local scaffolding and agent setup without any Cloud login.
helix chef is an interactive, one-shot bootstrapper. It installs the HelixDB query skills and docs MCP, scaffolds a project, starts a local instance
